title: Dashboard: Responsive Layout with All Widgets
description: Final dashboard layout. MOBILE-FIRST with Tailwind Grid, collapsible sections, excellent UX/UI.

technicalContext.ui: Tailwind CSS Grid + Flexbox responsive layout
technicalContext.sections: Continue Learning (top), Goals + Streak (side by side), Stats, Languages, Songs, Vocabulary, Queue
technicalContext.responsive: MOBILE-FIRST: Single column stack 320px+, grid layouts on md/lg/xl
technicalContext.tailwind: Use Tailwind: grid, gap, container, max-w, px responsive padding

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create Tailwind responsive grid layout for dashboard
Desktop (lg+): 2-3 column layout with logical grouping
Mobile (320px+): Single column stack with collapsible sections
Top section: 'Continue Learning' cards (most important, always visible)
Side by side on md+: Goals progress + Streak calendar
Full width: Stats overview with language breakdown
Below: My Songs, My Vocabulary (collapsible/expandable on mobile)
Add navigation link to dashboard in header (when logged in)
TAILWIND RESPONSIVE: Verify sm/md/lg/xl breakpoint transitions
UX: Logical visual hierarchy, easy scan, no horizontal scroll anywhere
UI: Consistent spacing (Tailwind gap/p utilities), section headers, dividers
